items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: I was with her in a live performance at the Vine Street Bar & Grill which was — a lot of recordings were done at Vine Street — Pete Jolly, Bob Mayes, Gordon Briscer was on it

ctx.x: Uh huh. What was she like in the studio? © Fillius Jazz Archive -28-

I was never with her in the studio. I was with her in a live performance at the Vine Street Bar & Grill which was — a lot of recordings were done at Vine Street — Pete Jolly, Bob Mayes, Gordon Briscer was on it, a very nice man. He’s since gone to his reward.
